---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something Cairn should do
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem this solves**
What are you trying to do on the trail that Cairn does not help with yet?

**What you have in mind**
A description of the feature.

**Alternatives you have tried**
Other apps, workarounds, paper maps.

**Note**
Cairn is deliberately small: no accounts, no social features, no turn-by-turn voice. Safety
information (fires, weather, closures) is never behind a purchase. Requests that fit that
shape are most likely to land.
